trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below: story first, then side characters, activities, collectibles and the 100% cleanup. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to its end; the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the first story trophy and cannot be missed, since the mission is part of the main path. PowerPyx lists it as the opening story beat and EGamers confirms it is one of the 28 hidden trophies.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing PowerPyx flags as possibly missable: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony when she talks about meditating, and accept. That balcony meditation may count toward Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops when the chapter completes. From Chapter 2 onward Jason and Lucia are both playable together after the Coffee Break point, which is what opens the last meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude, so keep the story moving. EGamers lists this as a hidden chapter trophy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. There is no mission replay, so save manually at the start and end of each chapter as PowerPyx advises, but nothing in this chapter can lock you out of the platinum. Keep scanning vehicles and animals as you go, since that progress counts toward later trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when it ends. Chapter 4 holds the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which opens the bank vault robberies needed for Maximum Withdrawal, so take that mission when it appears rather than rushing past the chapter. EGamers confirms this is a hidden chapter trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story and this gold trophy pops. Some lists word it as completing Chapter 5; either way it is the story's end and it cannot be missed. After the credits the game continues in free-roam, so everything left for the platinum stays available. PowerPyx notes there is free-roam after the story but no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops at its end. It is a main-path mission, so just keep playing the story; there is no special requirement beyond finishing it. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops. It is a main story mission, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapters; no side requirement is attached to it. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops at its end. Like the other mission trophies it is on the main path and cannot be missed. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners and the trophy pops. It is a main-path mission, so keep following the story; nothing extra is needed. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport and the trophy pops. It is a main story mission and cannot be missed. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops. It is on the main path, so it comes with normal story progress and cannot be missed. EGamers lists it among the hidden story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story to see the checklist; progress made during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and puts its thresholds at roughly 60 percent of true completion, with most of the work coming from other trophies: robberies, collectibles, challenges and activities. KeenGamer's breakdown lists 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 cocaine flamingos on the checklist. Nothing on it is missable, so finish it last in free-roam.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, and other stunt types all count. EGamers reports that flying under bridges is the quickest kind to farm. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road. PowerPyx lists this among the long grind trophies.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type in the game: the starter list counts 9 activity types. Open the map and work through the activity icons one by one, doing a single session of each, and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. It pairs naturally with the other activity trophies, so do it while you are out trying fishing, races and the shooting range.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges in Leonida. Visit each range, learn its target pattern, and replay challenges until you hit the gold score; the range keeps your best medal, so you can improve one challenge at a time. PowerPyx counts 42 challenges in total and EGamers confirms the 100% checklist also asks for all 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations; PowerPyx counts 42 races across those locations. Learn each course's gates and shortcuts, and replay a location until you win there. The 100% checklist also needs the drone races, so this trophy and the checklist overlap. EGamers points to a dedicated drone race guide for the course list.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida; each race counts once, so spread your wins over new events instead of repeating one. EGamers notes the 100% checklist asks for 30 unique race wins, so keep racing past 20 if you are chasing A Long Road. Any race type counts, so pick the vehicle classes you are strongest in.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than yanking, and retry the challenge if Cal wins the first round. The official description names only the win over Cal, so the challenge itself is the whole requirement.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and play one arcade game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you can finish. It is a quick trophy that also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Andy's quests are Lucia-only, according to GTASpotter's roadmap notes, so play them as Lucia. PowerPyx notes that quest givers who vanish for a stretch of the story all come back later, so if Andy is unavailable, keep playing the story and return in free-roam. EGamers lists this as a hidden side-character trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission chain through to his final mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story, but PowerPyx says all trophy-related quest givers return later, so keep playing and come back in free-roam if he is missing. EGamers lists this as a hidden side-character trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Start the chain as soon as it unlocks and keep an eye on the map for Billy's icon between story missions. EGamers lists this as a hidden side-character trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. These are the question-mark stranger missions scattered over the map; each strand is a small chain, and it counts when the chain ends. TechWiser, quoted by EGamers, warns that some stranger chains have windows tied to story progress, so start each strand as soon as it appears rather than leaving it for the end. PowerPyx notes the trophy-related quest givers all return in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission chain through to his final mission. Watch for Randy's icon on the map between story beats and work through his jobs in order. EGamers lists this as a hidden side-character trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's mission chain to its final mission and complete it. Tyrone's quests are Jason-only, according to GTASpotter's roadmap notes, so play them as Jason. If Tyrone is unavailable for a stretch, keep playing the story; PowerPyx says trophy-related quest givers return later. EGamers lists this as a hidden side-character trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida, using both Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase both flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, offered after the mission Down to Earth when she says she is going to meditate; follow her and accept, because it disappears once Chapter 1 ends and it is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the 18. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you A Long Road. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting work and bring down the unique animal he asks for. EGamers notes which animal is unconfirmed in the early guides, so follow Bret's own instructions in game when the hunt opens. Bret's quests are Jason-only, according to GTASpotter's roadmap notes. The 100% checklist also needs the Bret quests, so this trophy overlaps with A Long Road.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect every card in a set to complete it, and do it three times over. EGamers notes the 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets, so this trophy is an early milestone on a much longer hunt. Track sets as you go so you know which cards are still missing.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Open WAiNK at landmarks, businesses and scenic spots; each new location counts once. The 100% checklist also asks for 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist finish together. Work it in while exploring for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges, which come in eight groups of ten according to PowerPyx. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more, so they fill in naturally as you play; check the challenges menu to see which are close to done and finish those first. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so keep going past 50 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then lose the cops and escape the red heat zone on the map. EGamers reports both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level you need. Stay with your partner until the heat is fully gone, or the trophy will not pop.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time: do not lose the wanted level between robberies. EGamers reports the north Vice City jewelry stores sit close together, which makes the chain easier, and GTABase says to rob a fourth shop if the trophy does not pop after the third. Keep your partner with you and move fast between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, says you scan vehicles with WAiNK and do not need to drive them, and scanning traffic near busy roads is efficient. Scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you pass while playing the story, and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill your Combat Focus meter first, then trigger it and take down 5 enemies before it runs out. EGamers reports the guides recommend an assault rifle and aiming at gang members, since cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count. Pick a fight with a gang in the open, where five targets are close together, and do not waste Focus time reloading.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an aircraft at Vice City International Airport and take off without a schedule. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, says to steal a docked passenger jet and fly about 1 km away from the airport. Expect a wanted level the moment you grab the plane, so take off fast and keep flying until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and fight from inside it. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, says the tank comes from Mile Zero Air Station: take it and take out enemies from inside. Expect heavy resistance at a military site, so bring armor and a fast escape plan for getting in, then let the tank do the work.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without anyone spotting you. EGamers reports the method the guides describe: open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and clear out the safe without being seen. Move slowly, watch the staff, and leave before any alarm goes up; being detected at any point voids the attempt, so retry if you are spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. EGamers reports the route the guides describe: the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is opens vault robberies, after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist asks for 8 vaults, so keep going past 5 for A Long Road.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape with the cash. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads; block one, crack it open, grab the money and lose the wanted level that follows. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape much easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida until the map fog is cleared everywhere. EGamers reports that flying over the dark patches is the quickest method, since the map reveals from the air. Work through the fog region by region in a plane or helicopter, and pair the flying with WAiNK stops for You WAiNKer! and vehicle scans for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, says one operation per gang is enough, so find each gang's operation on the map and hit them one at a time. The 100% checklist asks for 39 gang operations in total, so this trophy is the first step of a longer robbery grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach and enjoy it. PowerPyx marks this trophy's exact steps as not yet known, and EGamers lists its steps as unconfirmed, so treat it as a relaxed visit: go to Ocean Beach, find the bar or lounge with the view, and order the cocktail there. Check the early guides again before a dedicated trip, since the method was still being worked out at launch.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's window, in the classic style the description hints at. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, thinks it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, but PowerPyx marks the exact steps as not yet known, so this is still unconfirmed at launch. Try it at a showroom in Vice City: get a car inside, build speed, and smash out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game with a proper follow-through. EGamers lists the wording as unclear, so the exact trigger is still being pinned down: play a full game at that alley and the trophy should pop on a completed frame. It also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build the partnership up until it reaches mass appeal. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, links this trophy to maxing out Strength for both characters, so train both Jason and Lucia at the gym and in combat until their Strength is maxed. Strength grows through workouts and fighting, so fold it into your normal play rather than grinding it in one sitting.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, puts the count at 500 profile-changing actions, though that is from a single source, so treat the number as reported rather than certain. Play the way the game wants: rob, race, fight and make the criminal choices the profile tracks, and check the profile in the pause menu to watch the count climb. PowerPyx warns the Irredeemable profile rating is permanent, so check a Criminal Profile guide before going on a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try. PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known and EGamers lists it as unconfirmed, so the exact trigger was still a mystery at launch: the description suggests failing once and then succeeding at the same thing right after. Keep it in mind while playing and retry anything you fail; check the early guides again before hunting it deliberately.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness a strange event somewhere in Leonida. GTABase, quoted by EGamers, thinks it refers to a strange event out in the world, but PowerPyx marks it as not yet known, so the exact event was unconfirmed at launch. Explore the odd corners of the map, especially at night, and the trophy should pop when you stumble into the right scene. Check the early guides again before hunting it deliberately.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. EGamers lists the steps as unconfirmed, so the practical read is simple: get a car, get a melee weapon ready, drive past a pedestrian at speed and swing as you pass. Do it away from heavy police patrols so you can line up the pass cleanly.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your fences and contacts. EGamers reports that one fence pays the most and the total grows during the 100% robberies, so keep laundering every bill you earn from robberies instead of sitting on them. The total is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it finishes on its own if you launder as you go.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops in Leonida: clothes, weapons, food, car mods and anything else you buy all count toward the same pot. It is cumulative, so normal spending across a full playthrough gets most of the way there; top it up late with a big purchase such as a vehicle upgrade or a weapon if you are short. Track it against Dime on the Dollar, since both are money trophies that finish in cleanup.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app. EGamers reports the total is around $160,000 and the 4 story garages do not count toward the 8, so only the ones you buy yourself matter. Save up during the story and buy them in free-roam; each purchase also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, take them to a registration point and add them to the app; each new vehicle counts once. Pair it with Whip It Good, since scanning a vehicle with WAiNK and then registering it covers two trophies with one car.
